meta.title: GD Webdesign – Modern Web Development & Digital Agency
meta.description: GD Webdesign creates modern, accessible, and custom websites for businesses with the highest standards for performance and design.

hero.title: Digital experiences that inspire and convert
hero.subtitle: We design and develop performant, accessible websites and custom web solutions for businesses looking to grow sustainably online.

services.title: Tailored web solutions for your success
services.lead: All from a single source: From thoughtful concepts and aesthetic design to first-class technical implementation.
services.primary_description: Modern, responsive websites with custom design, lightning-fast load times, and intuitive user guidance across all devices.
services.second_description: Optimized load times and technical search engine optimization for maximum visibility, excellent user experience, and technical quality.
services.third_description: Unique digital brand presence and thoughtful user journeys that inspire your target audience and build trust.
services.fourth_description: Flexible, secure, and low-maintenance web architectures – perfectly tailored to modular landing pages and modern web applications.
services.fifth_description: Reliable support after launch: Regular updates, security monitoring, and continuous ongoing development of your web project.

gallery.title: Excerpt of Our Digital Projects
gallery.lead: Explore a selection of our tailored web solutions and digital brand presences.
gallery.item1_description: Performant online store with accessible checkout experience and fast load times.
gallery.item2_description: Modern redesign for a medium-sized industrial enterprise with clear brand identity.
gallery.item3_description: High-converting landing page with interactive components and Jamstack architecture.
gallery.item4_description: Custom web portal with accessible UI and optimized loading speeds.

process.title: Your new website in three simple steps
process.lead: Clearly structured, collaborative, and without unnecessary complexity.
process.one_description: In an initial consultation, we analyze your goals, target audience, and requirements. We create a custom concept and a clear design framework.
process.two_description: We develop your project using modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. We strictly prioritize accessibility, performance, and responsive perfection on all devices.
process.three_description: After thorough quality assurance and review, we launch your new website live. Afterwards, we remain by your side as a reliable partner.

about.title: Quality, transparency, and technical excellence
about.description: As a specialized digital agency, we believe in lean, performant, and sustainable web architecture. Instead of bloated site builders, we rely on clean code, maximum accessibility, and custom web design.
about.feature_one_description: Optimal usability across all smartphones, tablets, and desktops.
about.feature_two_description: Developed with usability, security, and privacy in mind.
